build_retriever_clip: build a retriever that uses CLIP embeddings and FAISS for image similarity search
create_index_faiss: create a FAISS index from a HuggingFace dataset with CLIP image embeddings
retrieve_images_similar: retrieve the k nearest image examples from a FAISS index given an embedding vector
build_dataset_embeddings: build a dataset with CLIP image embeddings added as a new column
map_text_clip_embedding: map a text prompt to a normalized CLIP text embedding vector
